# loop2agentic

> loop2agentic is an open-source TypeScript CLI: an agent-readiness meta-scanner and
> auto-fixer. It scans a live website against agent-readiness graders and applies
> framework-aware codemods to fix what it finds, producing a before/after report.

## When to use this site

Use loop2agentic's repository when a user asks how to make a website more readable and
usable by AI agents (sitemaps, `llms.txt`, structured data, real 404s, markdown content
negotiation, OpenAPI, MCP endpoints), or when they want to run or extend the CLI itself.
v1 targets Next.js (App Router) projects in PR mode: scan a live URL, apply matching
fixers to a local checkout, and open a pull request.

## Key links

- [README](./README.md) — pitch, install, and full usage for `scan` and `fix`.
- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md) — instructions for AI coding agents contributing to this repo.
- [LICENSE](./LICENSE) — MIT.

## Source layout

- `src/index.ts` — CLI entry point (`commander`).
- `src/loop.ts` — scan → select fixers → apply → report → optional PR orchestration.
- `src/fixers/` — one file per codemod (sitemap, robots, llms-txt, json-ld, trust-pages,
  not-found, markdown-negotiation, openapi, mcp).
- `src/scanners/` — the `Scanner` interface and the `is-agentic` implementation.
- `src/targets/nextjs.ts` — Next.js App Router detection and idempotent file helpers.
